assessment: This is an important paper describing the role of Igf1 and a corresponding 47-gene network in alveologenesis and bronchopulmonary dysplasia. The authors provide compelling computational and experimental evidence of their findings in a mouse model. The authors also provide solid evidence that these processes are recapitulated in human tissue, however there are caveats around the set of control samples. This paper will be of interest to those interested in lung development and disease.
